entry.title: New: Resolution 290 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT TO ASSIST THE POLICE DEPARTMENT WITH PURCHASING CERTIFIED AGRICULTURAL SCALES

Transfers $1,500 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 6)
